Description: Learn to channel your inner dragon through the mastery of Dragonknight abilities.
Set your enemies ablaze in an inferno of destructive magic.
Control the field of battle with lethal poisons and furious strikes.
Channel your fury and charge into the fray like a raging, heavily-armored dragon.
Safeguard your allies by granting them powerful boons such as shields, health, and power.
Wield the power of death itself to strike fear into the hearts of your enemies as a terrifying Necromancer.
Control an army of the dead to overrun your enemies while channeling destructive elemental magic.
Use close strikes and ranged assaults to cripple your enemies with lethal poisons and diseases.
Drain the life from the living and dead alike to become an unkillable horror on the battlefield.
Stave off death's cold touch by siphoning power from the recently deceased and using it to aid your allies.
Grasp the sinister art of assassination by heeding the call of the Nightblade.
Sap the life-force from unsuspecting victims and use shadows to cast deadly spells.
Blindside your enemies with a flurry of poisonous strikes, then disappear without a trace.
Become one with the darkness, drawing your foes close, then crippling them with shadow and steel.
Siphon away your foe's vitality to fuel powerful healing spells, shielding you and your allies form death's embrace.
Master ancient spells that control deadly force as a powerful Sorcerer.
Channel the power of ice, fire, lightning and Oblivion to weave powerful, destructive spells.
Merge your martial and magical skill by empowering your weapon strikes with arcane energy.
Wade Confidently into battle, protected by heavy armor and potent sorcery.
Protect and bolster your allies with powerful wards and shields while draining your enemies of their vitality.
Extend your knowledge on brilliant Aedric spells through the Templar order.
Dazzle and burn your enemies with Aedric light while turning the battlefield to your advantage.
Visit swift justice upon your foes with stunning strikes up close and deadly arrows from afar.
Walk the path of a valiant knight and become an immovable, undying foe of the wicked.
Bring out the best in your allies by showering them with holy light, protective auras, and empowering spells.
Learn to harness the powers and beasts of nature as you traverse the ways of the Warden.
Summon up the wrath of the wild by calling on great beasts to overpower your enemies.
Use potent toxins and savage beasts to weaken your foes while you pelt them from afar with skillful archery.
Channel nature's resilience with freezing barriers and restorative, nourishing vines.
Draw on nature's bounty to summon plants that heal and empower your wounded allies.
The forces of tides, tentacles, and fate are close at hand. Rise, Arcanist, and take the power that is rightfully yours.
Combine turbulent elemental forces and the dread strength of Apocrypha to devastate your foes with overwhelming power.
Take up a dire blade and your Apocryphal tome to assault foes from close and mid-range.
Runes are your armor and the grace of Mora your shield. Sustain yourself against even the strongest assault through your connection to Apocrypha.
Your runes spark the swell of Abyssal tides, restoring your comrades through force of intellect alone.
